utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, I heard the carpool might shift a little this week—have you seen the latest schedule yet?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Not yet—can you confirm what changed?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: I haven’t seen the final update yet, but I’m happy to check and pass it along as soon as I do.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yeah, I’ll repeat the carpool plan to everyone and make sure it’s clear who’s riding with who.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thanks, Vik — I appreciate that. I might miss a detail, so a quick repeat would help.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Of course — I’ll go over the carpool plan again and make sure everyone knows their ride and time.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Hey Ira, what time should I be ready for the carpool?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I’d say be ready by 8:15 so we can head out on time.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Got it — I’ll be ready by 8:15.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Yeah, I can do the carpool if you still need me.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Rey — that helps a lot. I’ll keep you posted on the pickup details.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Sounds good — just send me the details when you have them.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Hi Jules, I can do the afternoon carpool this week if that still helps. What days are you thinking?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: That would be awesome, thanks Faye. I’m thinking Monday through Thursday if that works for you.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Monday through Thursday works for me. I can handle the afternoon carpool those days.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Morning, Oren. Let’s keep it simple—what time do you want to leave for the carpool?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Morning, Eli—uh, how about 7:30? That should give us a little cushion.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: 7:30 works for me. I’ll be ready at the curb a few minutes early.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hey Pia, I’m putting together the carpool and wanted to see if you want in. I can send you the details right away.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I might be able to, but I need to check the timing first. Send me the details and I’ll see if it works.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’ll send over the carpool details right now. Let me know if the timing looks doable for you!

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, thanks — I’m still catching up, so if there’s a carpool plan, could you fill me in?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Of course — I’ve got the carpool organized, and I can walk you through it now. We’re keeping it simple, so you can hop in without any fuss.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: That’d be great, thanks — what time should I be ready, and where do we meet?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Could you remind me of the pickup time and which kids are included? I want to make sure I’ve got the details right before I say yes.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Of course — I just need to double-check the carpool details before I confirm, so I don’t want to guess. I’ll get back to you with the pickup time and the kids included.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Mara — I’ll wait for the confirmed details before I commit.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Yeah, I can do my part for the carpool. Just keep me posted on the timing.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Thanks, Uli — I’ll keep you in the loop as soon as I know the timing.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Sounds good, Dane. I’ll be ready when you are.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing, Mina — if you need a booster seat, cooler, or anything else for the carpool, I’ve got you covered.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Thanks, Gus. Do you know what time the carpool leaves?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I’m not sure yet, but I can check with the group and let you know right away.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I can keep track of the carpool spots and timing if you want—just tell me where everyone’s meeting and I’ll note it down.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: That’d be great—let’s meet at my driveway at 7:30, and I’ve got Sam and Mia covered.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Got it—I’ll note your driveway at 7:30, with Sam and Mia covered.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing, Rey — I can help with the carpool. What time do you need me and who’s riding with us?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Gus. I need you at 7:30, and it’s just me and Lena riding with us.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Got it — I’ll be there at 7:30 for you and Lena.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m a bit worried about the timing—what time are we leaving, and how many stops are we making?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: I’d like to confirm too—what time are we leaving, and are there any extra stops?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’d feel better if we left a little earlier, just to buffer traffic. And if there are any extra stops, could we keep them to one?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Sure thing — I can help keep the carpool organized. What’s the plan for pickup and drop-off?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Great — I’ll handle pickup at 8:15 from the corner by the park, and you can take drop-off after school. I’ll text you if anything changes.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Perfect, that works for me — I’ll handle drop-off after school and keep an eye out for your text if anything changes.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I can keep an eye on the carpool supplies and check what we need before tomorrow. What time are you thinking for pickup?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I usually end up joining a bit late, so could we do pickup around 7:30? I’ll swing by as soon as I can.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: 7:30 works for me — I’ll make sure the carpool supplies are ready by then.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, right — the carpool. I heard it might be easiest to swap pick-up days if that helps, but I can check who’s available.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: That would help a lot, thanks — I can take whichever days make the most sense around school pickup.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Perfect — I’ll ask around and see who can cover which days, then I’ll circle back with a simple plan for us.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sure — just send me the pickup time and I’ll do my best to fit it in.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Bo — I’ll send the pickup time by this afternoon and keep you posted if anything changes.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good — I’ll keep an eye out this afternoon. Thanks, Rosa.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure thing, Leo — I’m happy to help with the carpool. What days and times are you thinking?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Thanks, Sam. I’m thinking weekday mornings around 8 and pickup at 5, if that works for you.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: That should work for me most weekdays. Just let me know which days you need, and I’ll plan for 8 and 5.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Oh, great—I'm already looping a few neighbors in for the carpool. If you want, I can add you to the group text too.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, that’d be really helpful—thanks. I’m still catching up on the details, so please add me to the group text.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely, I’ll add you right now and send over the details as soon as they’re in the group text.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I can keep track of the carpool spots—just let me know where everyone’s starting from and I’ll map it out.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That sounds good, Opal. I’ll jot down everyone’s starting points and bring you a clear list.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Perfect—once you have the list, I’ll line up the spots and make sure the route is easy to follow.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Are we still on for the carpool tomorrow morning?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I think so, but let me double-check the time and route first.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Okay — can you let me know as soon as you confirm?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Oh, good timing—I was just out running errands. How’s the carpool looking?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Hey Ira—yeah, it’s looking okay, I think. I might need to double-check the pickup times, though.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Got it—double-checking the pickup times sounds smart. Let me know if you want me to help sort it out.
